thread:
Priya: Brainstorm: build a "latency-dollar map" as the main visual for launch. quadrant style so folks instantly see tradeoffs. top-left = fast+cheap, bottom-right = slow+expensive.
Dario: nice metaphor. can we map actual configs: hosted-default, hosted-burst, dedicated-small, dedicated-optimized, private-onprem?
Priya: yes. plot median latency (ms) on y-axis, unit cost ($ / 1k tokens) on x-axis. add a small color cue for tail risk (95th).
Lucas: visuals: quadrant scatter + hover-callouts for example workloads (chat, summarization, embeddings). below that, a mini heat row showing typical batching gains (no batching vs batching vs caching).
Neha: copy angle: "See where your workload lands" + subhead "Pick the deployment that matches the latency and cost you actually need." CTA: webinar + benchmark download.
Sam: routing: capture 'primary use case' on the signup (chat / documents / embeddings) and 'deployment preference' (hosted/dedicated/private). map to SDR tags: Self-serve, Sizing-needed, Enterprise-touch.
Maya: add 'deployment urgency' (pilot / production) so we can prioritize Solutions Eng for hot enterprise leads.
Dario: engineering can supply numbers by Tue: sample numbers I'll drop: hosted-default median 120ms, cost $0.85/1k; hosted-burst median 95ms, cost $1.40/1k; dedicated-optimized median 210ms, cost $0.30/1k; private-onprem median 260ms, cost $0.25/1k (ballpark).
Priya: good — we'll surface 95th latency as a small dotted line in the scatter tooltip. keep chart copy simple: "Median latency vs unit cost." one-sentence takeaway under chart.
Lucas: I'll mock the quadrant frames in Figma after lunch. figma-bot can create starter components?
figma-bot: Created file: https://figma.com/redwood/bench/latency-dollar-map-v1  three frames: quadrant, batching-row, micro-takeaways.
Neha: testing headlines: 1) "Where speed meets spend: an LLM serving map" 2) "Which deployment gives you the latency and cost you need?" Thoughts?
Priya: prefer #2. it's clearer for product/ops readers.
Sam: webinar format idea: 20min walkthrough of map + 15min live demo (switch configs) + 25min audience Q&A. we'll gate demo registration for high-intent leads.
Neha: social variants: short: "New: Latency-dollar map for LLM serving. Pick the right deployment." mid: "Benchmark-driven guide to choose Hosted, Dedicated, or Private. Live demo and downloads." long: "Join our webinar to see real numbers and learn how to match latency and costs to your product needs. Includes live config switching demo."
Priya: exec quote draft: "We built the map to make serving tradeoffs obvious — pick what matches your user expectations and budget." need CEO approval.
Dario: also include one slide that calls out "quick wins" — batching+cache reduces unit cost by ~35% for chat workloads in our tests.
Lucas: visual note: avoid dense legends. use direct labels and one-sentence caption per frame. colorblind-friendly palette.
Sam: registration form fields confirmed: email, company, role, deployment interest, primary use case, pilot vs prod. tag leads in CRM accordingly. routing doc to be sent to sales today.
Neha: I'll draft landing copy + 3 email follow-ups (thank you + benchmark PDF + trial offer).
Maya: timeline: figma comps Mon, numbers Tue, copy Wed, landing up Thu, webinar next Wed. everyone ok?
Dario: on it. uploading CSV to /marketing/bench/bench-data-396812.csv when ready.
Priya: thanks team. keep this thread for updates only. small ask: when posting results, include a plain-language note about assumptions (prompt lengths, tokenization, batch sizes) so we don't mislead non-technical readers.
Neha: will add an assumptions section in the PDF.
Maya: perfect. closing the loop here. :rocket:
